annotations.title: Package registry config audit (.npmrc, pip, Maven, NuGet)

description: Package registry config audit (.npmrc, pip, Maven, NuGet) — Offline supply-chain review of package manager registry configs: .npmrc, .yarnrc.yml, pip.conf/pip.ini, .pypirc, Maven settings.xml and NuGet.config (format auto-detected, or pass format= npmrc|yarnrc|pip|pypirc|maven|nuget). Flags committed tokens (npm_, ghp_, glpat-, pypi-) and plaintext _authToken/passwords, credentials inside URLs, plain-HTTP registries, TLS verification turned off (strict-ssl=false, enableStrictSsl false, trusted-host), dependency-confusion setups (pip extra-index-url, NuGet sources without packageSourceMapping, Maven repos without a mirror), disabled checksums, bypassed Maven HTTP blocker, unsafe-perm, install scripts and missing hash pinning. Returns verdict, score, grade, findings with line numbers and fixes, plus registry hosts. Secret values are never echoed. Params: text= the file contents, or url= a raw file URL. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_registry_config_check
